questions.Description: Conduct an experiment to measure voltage, current and power in single phase a.c circuit by using Voltmeter, Ammeter and Wattmeter respectively for different loads.

Conduct an Experiment to calibrate the given Three Phase Energy Meter using Wattmeter and Stop Clock.

Conduct an Experiment to measure the Earth Resistance by using Earth Tester.
Conduct an Experiment to measure the value of unknown Inductance using Anderson Bridge.
Conduct an Experiment to measure the value of unknown Capacitance using Schering Bridge.

Thermocouple and RTD. (Any 2 transducer).
